sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - AKBS (Агентство Коммерческой безопасности Специзделия > Agentstvo Kommercheskoy Bezopasnosti Spetsizdeliya = "Agency for Commercial Security Specialized Products") was a Russian company founded in 1993 that made security equipment like small arms and ammunition. It was reorganized in 2012 as FORTUNA.
